a1_subject: A. Home page article offering and the John Gill part numbering

a3b_freshness2.note: the shelf is a curated choice, but the page mentions nothing newer than 2026-07-09

a4_gill_numbering.swap: two slugs carry the other part number

a4b_gill_numbering.visible_in_rail: /articles/dzhon-gill-chast-4-ekzeget/ links to chast-3-nasledie as «Читать Часть IV →» and lists chast-3 sections under «V. Историческое влияние»
a4b_gill_numbering.slug_semantics: slug says chast-3=nasledie, chast-4=ekzeget; content says nasledie is IV, ekzeget is III
a4b_gill_numbering.consequence: URLs, canonical, og:url, sitemap and feed keep the swapped numbers: a reader who memorised «Часть IV» lands on a page titled «Часть III»

b1_subject: B. The «SVG scheme» on /rodosloviye/ — what it actually is

b2_what_it_is.technology: React Flow (@xyflow/react) DOM graph, not a hand-authored SVG; one .react-flow instance
b2_what_it_is.status_line: Обзор / Показано 5 из 154 / Пунктир — путь через скрытые персоны
b2_what_it_is.node_box_vs_card: each .react-flow__node is 6x4 px at scale 0.0358784 while its inner .genealogy-node card measures 144x44 px (counter-scaled)
b2_what_it_is.layout_units: 4014x1226; canvas 1425x595; scale identical in 3 cold loads (0.0358784)

b3_keyboard_and_ax.defect: the accessibility tree exposes all 154 persons as named controls while the overview paints 5 and the keyboard reaches 5

b4_axe_rodosloviye.meaning: aria-label on a generic-role element is prohibited, so the 149 collapsed cards carry a name the platform is allowed to ignore

b6_retraction.claim: my first pass reported «154 nodes, 0 readable, scale 0.0359 => the atlas paints dust» and «two graph instances»
b6_retraction.why_wrong: the 6x4 node box carries a counter-scaled 144x44 card; the painted result matches the design (5 of 154, exactly as the status line says), and .react-flow count is 1 in every load
b6_retraction.method_fix: judge by screenshot + inner-card rect + hit test, not by the outer node box

c1_subject: C. The mobile menu/settings icons and the series text-glyph controls

c2_text_glyphs.markup: <button class="gbs2-ctl" aria-label="Переключить тему">◐</button> — no SVG at all
c2_text_glyphs.contrast_with_site: everywhere else the same actions use SVG (Gill bar: SVG sun/moon swap, gear for settings, share icon); the series is the only surface made of text glyphs

c3_theme_glyph_static.defect: a 2-quadrant circle that never changes: the control cycles day/night while the icon looks identical in both states and carries no pressed state
c3_theme_glyph_static.three_state_reader: the Gill settings sheet offers День / Сепия / Ночь with aria-pressed; from the series control sepia is unreachable

c4_genesis6_crumb.evidence: text-over-text collision in the screenshot (crumbs «Главная / Трудные тексты / Бытие 6» across «Господь Бог — Сила Моя»); the brand stays clickable (z-order), so it is a visual defect, not a hit-target defect
c4_genesis6_crumb.scope: only /hard-texts/genesis-6/ renders .genesis6-hub__breadcrumb; other sampled routes keep the header clean

c6b_contrast.widening: h-meta-time 139 + h-meta-author 4 + h-section-label 5 = 148 nodes of a new family in the existing row; colours are opaque, so axe is reliable here

c7_toast.created: at load, already filled with the message
c7_toast.evidence: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true, opacity 0, box 274x33 present from the first seconds; src/runtime/article-heading-anchors.js:24 sets textContent at creation and showToast() writes the same string again
c7_toast.consequence: the first copy does not change the live region, so the announcement is not guaranteed (only the visual class changes)
c7_toast.owner: same file as the heading-name row; recorded as a widening note there, not a new row
